review_scope: Complete Chinese–English alignment reading, including headings, source title and deck. Existing English is complete; two localized corrections proposed, pending independent correction review.

changes.before: Those judgments belong to soldiers and statesmen.
changes.after: Those judgments belong to military strategists and political leaders.
changes.reason: 军事家与政治家 identifies the responsible military/political decision-makers; soldiers was overbroad.

changes.before: Sunzi wrote that the highest use of arms is to attack the opponent's strategy. That line has been quoted for two thousand years, usually as the summit of war wisdom.
changes.after: Sunzi wrote that the highest use of arms is to attack the opponent's strategy. That line has been quoted in the Chinese-speaking world for more than two thousand years, usually as the summit of war wisdom.
changes.reason: Restore 中文世界 and 两千多年, retaining the original scope and duration rather than a worldwide unqualified claim.
